examples: The agent is stuck: restart it and carry on with the same conversation.
You changed your claude launch profile: restart a session so it relaunches with the new one.
Keep one session on a specific account without thinking about the active account each time you restart it.
how_to: Choose restart the agent. A picker shows what will happen: the launch profile dropdown starts on the one the agent was launched with, and says whether the conversation resumes.
To replace an agent that is still running, tick the arm box first; the tick is the confirmation.
Confirm. The session comes back in the same row with its conversation resumed.

On a claude session, click choose account under the launch profile to pick the account to restart on. Leave the box unticked for a one-time choice, which also clears a saved account. Closed, the link leaves the agent on its saved account, else the active one.

To restart at once, hold shift and open the row menu: restart now kills the running agent and resumes it in one click. If the pane was not measured running, the normal picker opens instead and says why.
name: Restart and resume a session
summary: restart a session and resume its exact conversation, with a picker that shows what will happen before you commit.
